full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 52
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Thursday, Bhadra 25, 2083
1:00 PM
Management Work
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle:
1. a) To present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   b) To introduce the "Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   c) To present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   d) To introduce the "Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
2. Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle to present a proposal for consideration of the "Employees' Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Treaty Related Work
3. Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, to present a proposal for general discussion on "Accepting Membership of the Council of Asian Legislative Institutions (CALI)".
Condolence Motion
4. Honorable Speaker to present a condolence motion on the demise of Shukraraj Samyuk, former member of the National Assembly.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The Finance Minister sought and received leave to introduce two bills: the "Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083" and the "Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083". He also presented a proposal for consideration of the "Employees' Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083".
